[SWS_DM_00932]
UDS DTC status bit
3 / ’ConfirmedDTC’ after displacement
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04067, RS_Diag_04118
⌈
If an event memory entry was removed during displacement AND the configuration
parameter
DiagnosticCommonProps.resetConfirmedBitOnOverflow
is set to
"
true
", the DM module shall reset the
UDS DTC status bit
3 / ’ConfirmedDTC’ to
’0’.
⌋
